record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: SILICOBRA (1 star) and SANDACONDA (2 stars) declare SAND_SPIT (passive NONE, maxPP 80, range 1). The strategy is shared; only the damage depends on the casting unit's stars. Units not listed are not covered.
record.summary: Cone attack in front of the caster. The caster turns toward its cast target (getCellsInFront overwrites pokemon.orientation), and the three cells one step away in that orientation and its two neighbouring orientations are collected (off-board cells dropped). Every ENEMY occupying one of those cells takes special damage (raw table 30 / 60 / 120 / 240 by caster stars: SILICOBRA 30, SANDACONDA 60) and is then Blinded for a fixed 2000 ms. The blind call is made regardless of what the damage call returned, so a victim that is protected, skydiving or has magicBounce still receives the blind (unless already blinded or Rune Protected). Unlike NIGHT_DAZE, the blind duration is NOT AP-scaled (triggerBlinded is called without apBoost, default false), only halved if the victim is enraged and then reduced by the victim's duration reductions. Requested damage (table), applied damage (after AP, crit, defenses, floor of 1) and the returned takenDamage (shield damage included, not read here) are three different amounts. No heal, PP gain or shield is part of this ability, so the shared heal rules (core-mechanics.md section J) do not apply.

targeting.who: the cast target fixes the orientation only; victims are all enemies standing in the three front cells, which need not include the cast target itself
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the default true. Allies in the cells are skipped; empty cells skipped. Whether the cast target is always inside the three cells (range 1 unit, adjacent target) was not traced for displaced or confused casters.

geometry.shape: three cells at distance 1 from the caster: in the orientation toward the target and in the two orientations next to it in OrientationArray (indexes +1 and +7 mod 8); clipped at board edges; the range argument is the constant 1

effects.target: each enemy in the three front cells

declaredRaw.label: raw special damage by caster stars (requested amount)

effects.scaling: requested = 30 (SILICOBRA) / 60 (SANDACONDA). Applied: x(1 + caster AP/100) (apBoost default true); crit factor 1 + (critPower - 1) x reduction only if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT; canCritByDefault is false)
effects.resolution: handleSpecialDamage returns {death:false, takenDamage:0} and deals nothing when the victim is protected, skydiving or has magicBounce (magicBounce additionally reflects damage x star factor to the caster unless the caster holds Protective Pads). Otherwise PokemonState.handleDamage: special damage / (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef), armorReduction halves speDef, minimum 1 after Math.ceil, shield absorbs first, enraged attacker multiplier. Three amounts: requested = table; applied = after AP / crit / defense / floor of 1; takenDamage (returned, includes shield damage, unused here). Each victim gets the full damage (no split). No heal is derived from the damage.

effects.target: each enemy in the three front cells
effects.scaling: requested 2000 ms, no AP scaling (apBoost omitted)

statusEffects.target: each enemy in the three front cells

declaredRaw.label: fixed raw duration before enrage and reductions

statusEffects.scaling: requested = 2000 ms; NOT AP-scaled (triggerBlinded default apBoost = false, so the origin's AP is ignored); no star or crit scaling
statusEffects.resolution: Requested vs applied. Applied only if the victim is not already blinded and has no rune protect (a blinded victim is NOT refreshed); protect/skydiving/magicBounce do not prevent it. Then /2 if the victim is enraged, then SWIFT_SWIM x0.7 / HYDRATION x0.5 / WATER_VEIL or SURGE_SURFER x0.3 and Odd Keystone -10% each, rounded into blindCooldown. Effect found: while blinded, the victim's basic attacks give their target +0.5 dodge chance; the dodge roll is skipped by XRAY_VISION, LOCK_ON and against a paralysed, sleeping, frozen or locked target. Ends when blindCooldown runs out. Effects on abilities or movement were not found.

starBehavior.note: Only the damage table is indexed by the casting entity's stars (fallback 240); the blind duration and the cone size are fixed. Whether other mechanics change an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: The cone is oriented from the caster's position toward the cast target at cast time; damage and blind are applied cell by cell in the collected order, and a cell's occupant is read from the cell snapshot taken before the loop. Allies and empty cells are skipped.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: Single mode. Each cast spends maxPP (80) of PP via the base process and overwrites the caster's orientation. No stored state between casts.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: special damage 30 / 60 raw and Blinded 2000 ms raw (no AP) on each enemy in the three front cells. Applied: damage after AP, crit, speDef and the floor of 1 (zero if protected / skydiving / magicBounce); blind after the already-blinded / rune-protect guards, enrage halving and duration reductions (still applied when the damage was blocked).
